memories.text: S: k/c/o AF, dx 2024. c/o palpitations on exertion; no syncope. O: BP 132/80, pulse 96 irregular. A: AF, rate borderline controlled. HTN, near target. P: 1. Metoprolol (Metolar) 25 mg BD. 2. Continue warfarin per INR clinic. Adv: limit caffeine. R/V in 3 months.
